title: Beryl
subtitle: Australian Payroll Association · SSW
description: The Australian Payroll Association's AI payroll agent. It answers only from APA's vetted knowledge base and live government pages, rewrites questions to strip hidden assumptions, hands anything that looks like legal advice to a human specialist, and is scored weekly against APA's experts. Won AI Innovator (Accountancy Services) at the 2025 Australian AI Awards.

title: Eddy
subtitle: Training app with a Claude coach
description: An all-in-one training app for strength, calisthenics, recovery and protein. A training engine tracks per-muscle recovery and weekly sets; Claude plans the sessions over MCP and they land on the app's Today screen. Syncs with Strava through a small token gateway.

title: Oxide
subtitle: A super light text editor
description: A text editor that opens instantly, highlights code and formats on save. Multiple cursors, live find and replace with regex, incremental syntax highlighting. Ships for macOS, Windows and Linux, with a Homebrew cask.

title: This Website
subtitle: A desktop in your browser
description: A personal site reimagined as a desktop environment: a draggable window manager, dock, terminal and games, built from scratch.

title: WTFU
subtitle: Wake the f*** up
description: An iPhone alarm that keeps ringing until you get out of bed and scan a registered NFC tag, barcode or QR code.

title: Lime → Strava
subtitle: Reverse-engineered rider API
description: Lime has no public API, so I documented the app's private one and built a sync on top of it. Every bike or scooter ride lands on Strava as a GPS activity with the route drawn on the map, run unattended from a Cloudflare Worker.

title: Saved You 20 Minutes
subtitle: Browser extension
description: Hover a YouTube thumbnail, click Worth it?, and an LLM reads the transcript to give you the payoff the title was dangling, a WORTH IT / SKIM IT / SKIP IT verdict, and the two or three things the video actually says.

title: Cert Tracker
subtitle: GitHub and Azure exam prep
description: A study and quiz site for the GH-600, GH-100, GH-300 and AI-103 certifications: every unit of the official learning paths, every published objective covered by at least two questions, and a domain-weighted mock exam per cert.

title: Impossible Spaces
subtitle: Honours thesis · VR
description: Overlapping rooms joined by portals, so you can physically walk through a virtual world far bigger than the room you stand in. The thesis maps every known impossible-space technique and introduces Impossidraw, a web tool for drawing impossible floor plans and exporting them as 3D models for Unity.

title: Head-Controlled Flying
subtitle: VR locomotion
description: Flying through a virtual world steered by head movement alone, no controllers.

title: Kryptochat
subtitle: First-year web app
description: A small messaging app that demonstrates Diffie-Hellman key exchange. Private keys never leave the browser; the server only ever sees public keys and ciphertext.
